name: cc-okf
description: Gives Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles in ~/.claude/okf the treatment Claude Code gives skills and memory: a table of contents in context, annotated reads, and frontmatter search.

tocBudgetTokens.title: Table of contents budget (tokens)
tocBudgetTokens.description: Upper bound for the OKF table of contents added to each conversation, across all bundles.

bundlesDir.title: Bundles directory
bundlesDir.description: Directory whose subdirectories are OKF bundles. Empty uses $OKF_DIR, then $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/okf, then ~/.claude/okf. A leading ~ means your home directory.
